chunks: Indeed, the governor has his favourites and inner circle; among them is misappropriation, arrogance, and a lack of fairness in dealings,
so cut off the root of those [people] by severing the causes of those conditions.
ai.seo_question: How should a governor manage the corruption and arrogance of his inner circle?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) instructs Malik al-Ashtar to dismantle the systemic corruption of the governor's inner circle by severing the very mechanisms that enable their greed, arrogance, and unfairness in transactions. This directive reflects the Shia political principle of 'qat' al-asbab' (cutting off the causes), emphasizing that effective governance requires structural reform of administrative practices rather than merely punishing individual offenders. The advice underscores the necessity of transparency and justice in public trust to prevent the entrenchment of elite privilege.
